minutes.headline: EDC to get a new $3,000 revolving fund account for event sponsorship, pending town meeting approval
minutes.summary: The Economic Development Committee reviewed planning-office initiatives (minor site plan zoning reform, a redevelopment forum for the old gas station site, and a new business-notification pipeline), discussed a wish list of low-cost ways to support new businesses, and heard that an article for a $3,000 EDC revolving fund is going to annual town meeting. Minutes for January 13, 2026 were approved after an initial date mix-up; no formal votes were taken on any other business.

what_happened.line: An article to create an EDC revolving fund account for event sponsorship, with an amount as heard, is going to annual town meeting.
The planning director was directed to draft four zoning amendments, including minor site plan review, ahead of the May town meeting.
The town clerk's office will now notify the planning office of new business-certificate filings so the EDC can send a welcome email.
A public forum on redeveloping the old gas station site at 925 Massachusetts Ave is planned ahead of an RFP, with cleanup costs shaping the town's asking price.
The EDC has no budget to fund ribbon cuttings until the new fiscal year and will instead route new businesses to the Chamber of Commerce.

why_it_matters: Annual town meeting will be asked to approve a new revolving account the EDC could use to bring in and spend money on event sponsorship.
Zoning amendments drafted this summer, including a minor site plan review provision, could appear on the May town meeting warrant and change what review new development faces.
A planned public forum on the old gas station site precedes an RFP for its sale, and cleanup costs are expected to factor into the price the town sets.
